observations: Probe allocates order-2 pages (0x4000 bytes) and links sixteen 0x400-byte FIFO nodes; the mmap body maps exactly 0x4000 bytes from state+0x610 using remap_pfn_range.
Stock RTP work and the threaded IRQ inspect node state for U; the worker and FIFO helper read length/payload and set consumed nodes to 0xff.
The stock richtap_write body returns the supplied count and does not publish FIFO nodes. The ioctl 0x5209 path copies a separate RTP buffer to state+0x608; it is not the mapped FIFO producer.

The mapped producer therefore lies outside the kernel sources available in this repository. A scoped search of source files outside reverse_engineering/validation found no userspace Richtap producer implementation.

The candidate IRQ/worker mutex serializes kernel consumers and state transitions; a userspace producer does not take that mutex. No release/acquire publication contract can be established from the available client sources. The stock consumer paths use ordinary state loads; the candidate preserves those stock bodies.
interpretation: Potential publication-order assumption remains unverified. This review does not establish a race or runtime failure. Adding only a kernel-side acquire/barrier without the userspace producer contract would not prove correct publication and could diverge from stock.
required_next_evidence: Obtain the userspace Richtap client source or hash-bound client binary/disassembly, identify its FIFO state/payload stores and barriers, then compare that protocol with the kernel consumer. If unavailable, keep this gate explicitly open.
build: Not run: evidence-only review; no reconstruction source changed.
